title: sida diffusa var. setosa
intro: Sida diffusa var. setosa, commonly known as 'Brihati' or 'Brihati phali', is a plant species belonging to the family Malvaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and various skin conditions, providing relief from pain, inflammation, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Sida diffusa var. setosa include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal effects and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
